meta.title: Parallel/Sequential Flow and Scheduling: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that parallel/sequential flow and scheduling each stage is refused or absent.
Repeat the same parallel/sequential flow and per-stage scheduling action as a Buyer and verify it is available.
Compare the two role outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that parallel/sequential flow and scheduling each stage is refused or absent.; Repeat the same parallel/sequential flow and per-stage scheduling action as a Buyer and verify it is available.; Compare the two role outcomes while accounting for tenant RBAC configuration.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user and then as a Buyer in the same tenant, exercise parallel/sequential stage flow and schedule each stage in both sessions, and report whether the capability is refused or absent for the non-Buyer and available for the Buyer

steps.note: The required role-specific sessions and the parallel/sequential flow controls are not available in the catalog.
Assert that the session remains free of visible application errors after the tester's role comparison.
